category_override: answered elsewhere; confirmed or written up here
notes: Thrackle conjecture verified for all graphs with n <= 12 vertices (Pammer 2014 thesis, cited in Aichholzer et al. GD 2019); n <= 11 earlier folklore. General conjecture open. No cheap extension: n = 13 needs a new full enumeration of path-thrackles. Outside Lean: everything (topological drawings, computer enumeration in the cited thesis).

sources.cite: J. Pammer, Rotation systems and good drawings, MSc thesis, TU Graz (2014)
sources.what: enumerates path-thrackles; conjecture holds for n <= 12

L. Goddyn, Y. Xu, On the bounds of Conway's thrackles, DCG 58 (2017) 410-416
R. Fulek, J. Pach, A computational approach to Conway's thrackle conjecture, Comput. Geom. 44 (2011)
